senses.def: A river in Bridgend borough county borough, southern Wales, which flows into the Bristol Channel at Ogmore-by-Sea.
A small settlement in St Bride's Major community, Vale of Glamorgan borough county borough, Wales, close to Ogmore Castle (OS grid ref SS8876).
A rural town in the Shire of Livingstone, Queensland, Australia.
A village in Ogmore Valley community, Bridgend borough, Wales (OS grid ref SS9390).
The valley of the River Ogmore (Cwm Ogwr in Welsh) in Bridgend borough, Wales.
A community (civil parish) in Bridgend borough, named after the valley.
